title: Untitled (Page on Targets)
description: Mixed-media collage centering a white rectangular panel mounted with two silver compact discs and a translucent form, bordered by concentric target circles in red, black, pink, and blue. Scattered elements include a black chess king figure, football fragments, printed text reading 'xxxiii dia,' additional CDs, and horizontal bands of graphic patterning along the perimeter.
composition: central pinned page on target field
dimensions_source: CD reference: the 2 silver compact discs mounted on the white panel, measured directly at ~310px and ~315px native diameter, 1.6% spread. The piece's concentric target circles (red/black/pink/blue) were explicitly excluded -- xeroxed motifs, not physical objects, see docs/current/DIMENSIONS-CD-REFERENCE.md. Estimated 2026-08-03.
